messages:
marisol: Heads up — EchoMed's daily API calls dropped ~48% since last week, embeddings steady. Saw a similar pattern? https://grafana.redwood/e/echo/usage
samir: thanks Marisol. Any change on procurement or exec sponsor?
marisol: Procurement swapped contacts last month — new lead is @kelly_proc and I haven't had an onboarding with them yet. Pinged for context. :eyes:
billing-bot: Alert: EchoMed invoice overdue by 5 days (amount $12,300) — subscription paused on 2026-02-27
amina: Can you share the top endpoints by token consumption? Could be client-side routing or a routing flag flip.
marisol: quick usage snippet:
```
endpoint,avg_tokens_per_call,daily_calls
/generate,430,1200 -> 620
/qa,70,340 -> 180
/embeddings,512,800 -> 795
```
oliver: Generate traffic down big — could be they started running a local gen model. Any sign of a competitor pilot?
lena: Sales note: Thassa ran an evaluation with EchoMed in Jan — they tested a low-latency on-prem inference.
samir: Okay — proposed immediate next steps:
1) @amina, schedule a 30m debug call with EchoMed engs to inspect request routing and auth headers.
2) @marisol, confirm with @kelly_proc & the sponsor whether procurement/contract delays are blocking usage.
3) I'll prep a concise cost vs latency deck and propose a 2-week dedicated pilot with SLA fallback.
4) @finance watch the invoice hold and advise on short-term reinstatement options.
marisol: Booking the eng debug for tomorrow 09:00 PT, inviting @samir @amina @lena. :+1:
kelly_proc: Thanks for flagging — procurement paused until we verify KMS/HSM integrations plus a 1-page SSO checklist.
amina: I can take SSO/KMS checklist to the call and demo our SAML flow; will also show the dedicated fallback config.
samir: If we can fast-track a 2-week dedicated pilot and address the KMS ask, we should recover usage and reduce renewal risk. Marisol, please capture outcomes in the CSM playbook and mark this as a "medium-high" renewal risk for now.
marisol: Will update the playbook and post a call summary after tomorrows session. Also logging action items in the account notes.
